units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 35:6">Targ. Job XXXV, 6</cite> (Ms. <he>פָּאצֵי</he>).

senses.gloss: (cmp. פָּדָה a. פָּדַע) to rescue, save. Ib. XXXVI, 16 פְּצָאִינָךְ (h. text הסיתך).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 22:9">Targ. Ps. XXII, 9</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17a:17">Ab. Zar. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>חד פָּצֵי לע״ז וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) one road branched off towards an idolatrous temple, and another to a house of prostitution.
<cite ref="Pesachim 111a">Pes. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>ואי פ׳</he> Ar. (Ms. O. 2 <he>פַּצְיָא</he>; Ms. O. 2 <he>אִיפְּסַע</he> ed. <he>ממצעין</he>) and if one (she) passes.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 70:2">Targ. Ps. LXX, 2</cite>.
Targ. Prov. XIV, 25 (ed. Wil. Af.).—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 45a:4">B. Bath. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>דינא הוא דמְפַצֵּי ליה מיניה</he> (or <he>דמַפְצֵי</he>) the law is that he (who sold the ass) must rescue it from him (the gentile that took it by force; i.e. must restore the ass to the buyer or indemnify him).
<cite ref="Ketubot 91b:16">Keth. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>לא מְפַצִּינָא לך</he> (or <he>מַפְצִינָא</he>) I shall not be bound to restore it to thee.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 2:12">Targ. Prov. II, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 2:16">16</cite>.
